# Cranmoor Veterinary Clinic - dispensary ledger

ledger/dispensed-YYYY-MM.txt logs what the in-house dispensary
handed out, one line per patient in the style of the existing
lines:

    <date> <patient> - <item> - dispensed - <vet>

Prescription sheets are kept in notes/. Items routed to the
outside pharmacy never enter this ledger; only dispensary rows do.
